QuestInfo.name: Moonlight Sonata Music Box
QuestInfo.1:
Gold Richie gives you the music box that plays Moonlight Sonata.  Take it to Baby Moon Bunny.
Visit Baby Moon Bunny on the moon.

#b#eTip:#n You can go to the moon through the [Dimensional Mirror] in town.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the music box made by Gold Richie to Baby Moon Bunny. Baby Moon Bunny looked surprised by the unexpected gift.\nBaby Moon Bunny says that the music is very beautiful and told you that it would treasure the music box. #bGrandpa Moon Bunny#k no doubt looks forward to hearing this.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 30,000\n\nCan proceed to the 'Grandpa Moon Bunny's Gratitude' quest

0.0: Here, take this music box. I'd bet my entire fortune that this music box has the most perfect Moonlight Sonata recorded into it.

yes.0: I hope that Baby Moon Bunny enjoys this music.

no.0: Did you suddenly change your mind? Well, I guess there is nothing I can do about it if you don't want the music box. Goodbye.

1.0: Huh? What's that music box? Is it a gift for me?\r\n#L0##bGrandpa Moon Bunny wanted me to give this to you. Do you want to listen to it now?#l\n#k
1.1: Wow! I want to listen to it right now! I just wind it up here?\n#b(Sweet music begins to flow from the music box.)#k

yes.0: Wow! The music is so beautiful. Is this what grandpa was always talking about? It's a great piece. I don't think I will ever forget this.

npc.0: I hope that Baby Moon Bunny enjoys listening to 'Moonlight Sonata' from this music box.

item.0: Grandpa Moon Bunny wanted me to listen to 'Moonlight Sonata,' but will I ever have the chance to?

lost.0: You lost the music box? Were you attacked by monsters, too? Oh well. I'm taking a loss, but I guess I'll create another music box. This is all for Baby Moon Bunny.
